forceNew.description: When true, start a new publish job even if this project already has a costume, clothes, or hair plate for the same image. Omit to reuse a matching ready or in-progress plate.

When true, start a new location publish job even if this project already has a location for the same image. Omit to reuse a matching published or in-progress location.

gender.description: Optional. Omit to inherit gender from the avatar catalogue.

age.description: Optional apparent age in years (1–1000). Omit to inherit from the avatar catalogue.

ethnicity.description: Optional appearance group for facial features, hair, and skin colour. Omit to inherit from the avatar catalogue.

species.description: Optional species override. Omit to inherit from the avatar catalogue.

style.description: Optional style override. Omit to inherit from the avatar catalogue.

sides.description: Viewpoint sides (0..2). Sibling of taxonomy — not nested inside it.

playerSide.description: Who the user plays (0..1). Sibling of taxonomy — not nested inside it.
